modmenu.summaryTranslation.locator_lodes: It addeth Lodestones unto thy Player Locator Bar.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.locator_l:
It addeth Lodestones unto thy Player Locator Bar.

Lodestone Compasses within thy Inventory (even those Bundled) do conjure Waypoints upon thy Locator Bar.
configs.locator_lodestones.screen_title: Locator Lodestones: Recontinued Configs, Good Sir
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_display.t: Whether holding the tab button forceth the locator bar to appear, be required for it to appear, or hath no effect (default)
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_shows_nam: Whether holding the tab button maketh the names of compass waypoints appear
configs.locator_lodestones.show_recovery: Whether Recovery Compasses do also create waypoints
configs.locator_lodestones.show_bundled_: Whether compasses in Bundles do also appear
configs.locator_lodestones.show_in_spect: Whether compass waypoints still appear in Spectator Mode
configs.locator_lodestones.color_customi: Whether the colour of waypoints may be changed by placing a hex code in the item name
configs.locator_lodestones.lodestone_col: The default colour for Lodestone Compass waypoints. May be set to 'random' to randomise it
configs.locator_lodestones.recovery_colo: The default colour for Recovery Compass waypoints. May be set to 'random' to randomise it
